facts.statement: The fidelity target is the current public Windows build 21020021, identified in-game as v1.1.2.a75ee335a.
facts.method: Cross-checked the installed Steam app manifest, live main-menu version label, and SteamDB public branch.

facts.statement: Vanilla play is one player against one player.
facts.method: Used official store scope and direct match recordings.

facts.statement: Each player begins by choosing one card from five offered cards.
facts.method: Counted the sequential starting choices in two independent recordings.

facts.statement: A duel kill awards the surviving player half of a round point.
facts.method: Matched the HALF player overlay and half-filled score circle after first kills in both recordings.

facts.statement: Two duel wins complete one round point.
facts.method: Observed HALF followed by ROUND overlays and a full score circle.

facts.statement: After a full round point, the losing player chooses one persistent card from five choices.
facts.method: Followed the ROUND overlay into the single-player five-card draft in both recordings.

facts.statement: The first player to five full round points wins the match.
facts.method: Cross-checked the five-dot score display, completed match footage, and community rules summary.

facts.statement: Chosen cards stack and persist through every later duel in the match.
facts.method: Tracked the growing card icons and retained effects across map changes.

facts.statement: A player can hold at most five cards in the vanilla five-point loop, including the starting card.
facts.method: Derived one starting card plus at most four loser drafts before the opponent reaches five points.

facts.statement: Each duel resets spawn position, health, ammunition, block cooldown, and transient projectiles while retaining cards and score.

tolerance.value: fresh combat state before control unlocks

facts.method: Compared the starts of consecutive duels in both recordings.

facts.statement: The arena remains for the two half-point duels and changes after a full round point.
facts.method: Followed arena continuity across half-point and full-point transitions.

facts.statement: A brief spawn presentation precedes each duel and player control unlocks together.
facts.method: Compared player motion and spawn animation at repeated duel starts.

facts.statement: A simultaneous death should replay the duel without awarding a half point until current-build observation proves otherwise.
facts.method: No clean simultaneous-death example appeared in the selected recordings, so the least score-distorting rule is explicit and provisional.

facts.statement: ROUNDS released on 2021-04-01, so the goal's 2020 label is treated as a naming error rather than a separate ruleset.
facts.method: Used the official Steam release date.
